{{Quote|There. Didn't I ''say'' this was going to be easy?|Han Solo, to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
This '''raid''' took place in [[44 ABY]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|Detention Center 81]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] where [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] were being held in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. The raid was led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], as well as [[Zekk]] and [[Taryn Zel]]. After fighting several guards, the Jedi and their allies were able to free the Horn siblings from carbonite.
